'''Surgok'k''' was an enormous [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slug]] that was being studied by the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Gray Secant]]'' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], where it was slain.

==Behind the scenes==
Surgok'k is one of three World Bosses added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Relics of the Gree World Event.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
